title: Functional Calibration for Trunk and Limb Inertial Sensors
author: Benedikt Fasel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jzncp5e

steps.title: Perform Slow Squats
steps.instruction: Do slow squats with knee, hip, trunk, and head flexion; keep arms parallel to the legs; flex until the fingers reach the ankles; repeat the movement three times.

steps.title: Hip Adduction/Abduction
steps.instruction: Execute slow hip abduction and adduction while balancing on ski poles; keep the right heel inline with the left toe, knee straight, and toes pointing forward with no external rotation; practice the correct movement a few times before the full calibration; then repeat the same sequence with the left leg.

substeps.instruction: Right leg: Perform slow hip abduction then adduction three times, heel inline with left toe, knee straight, toes forward.
Left leg: Perform the same abduction‑adduction sequence three times, maintaining the same posture.

steps.title: Trunk Rotations
steps.instruction: Perform slow trunk rotations around the vertical axis with hips fixed; hold a ski pole horizontally behind the neck; turn the head with the trunk, starting the rotation by looking to the right; repeat three times.

steps.title: Arm Up/Down Movements
steps.instruction: Perform slow arm up‑down movements in the sagittal plane with straight elbows; hold a pole horizontally with both thumbs pointing medially and hands spaced approximately shoulder‑width apart; avoid lifting the arms too high; repeat three times.

steps.title: Static Standing Pose
steps.instruction: Stand upright with knees slightly flexed, weight evenly on both feet, and gaze straight ahead; hold this position for 10 seconds.
